release: CoreSpirit v70 — composable language surfaces + progressive simplicity
runtime_baseline: v68 declarative AUTOMATE + universal ORDER intent
focus: composable indicator -> model -> event/when -> automation -> order-intent flow
serializable composition graph attached to the existing surface metadata
one value/event contract across compiler, IR, VM and host boundaries
beginner-first source progression from one-line show to model-driven automation
blue CoreSpirit/chart UI accent replacing the previous green product accent
architecture_invariants: indicators, model outputs, events, conditions, automations and order intents remain serializable contracts rather than parallel runtimes
composition metadata describes the existing executable artifact; it never executes code
MODEL outputs may feed ordinary expressions/WHEN and SHOW; EVENT emissions may feed WHEN; WHEN may trigger AUTOMATE; AUTOMATE may produce ORDER intent
one language -> one compiler -> one stable IR -> one VM -> multiple host execution environments
the beginner surface is shorthand that lowers to the same core grammar; no beginner-only evaluator exists
automation remains downstream of events/conditions and order intent remains downstream of risk/policy/execution authority
blue is the primary UI accent; market-positive/negative semantic colors remain independent from the product accent
